description: The CG-27 Regional Transport Office serves the Kondagaon district in Chhattisgarh, overseeing vehicle registration, driving license issuance, and transport law enforcement. Established following the district's formation in 2012, this office is a key administrative hub for the Bastar region's road transport services.
address: Office of the District Transport Officer, Collectorate Campus, Kondagaon, Chhattisgarh
